build.//: Three profiles for three different questions. `development` answers 'does the native code work on my phone', `preview` answers 'can I hand this to someone', `production` answers 'is this what goes to the store'.

preview.//: The one to build first. An .apk installs by tapping the file — no Play Store, no cable, no Android Studio — and unlike Expo Go it contains the real native modules, so push, biometrics and the camera actually work.
